quest.making_friends_with_my_arm.start: Burntmeat in Troll Stronghold; My Arm rooftop then Larry in north-west Rellekka.
prerequisites: My Arm's Big Adventure, Swan Song, Cold War, Romeo & Juliet
66 Firemaking (not boostable), 72 Mining, 35 Construction, 68 Agility (latter three boostable)
quest.making_friends_with_my_arm.route: Larry's boat to Weiss, rope/rock climb, troll stealth, cave swim and Mother's dialogue; Wise Old Man, mahogany coffin and cadava potion; prison combat, Snowflake's fire and goat dung.
quest.making_friends_with_my_arm.consumables: One bolt of cloth, five mahogany planks, cadava berries; rope consumed installing the ledge. Food budget is an estimate.
quest.making_friends_with_my_arm.reward: 2 QP, 10,000 Construction, 40,000 Firemaking, 50,000 Mining and 50,000 Agility XP.

quest.the_fremennik_exiles.start: Brundt at Rellekka longhall; Freygerd, the rockslide and Brundt's exile camp.
prerequisites: The Fremennik Isles, Lunar Diplomacy, Mountain Daughter, Heroes' Quest
65 Crafting, 60 Slayer, 60 Smithing, 60 Fishing, 60 Mining, 55 Runecraft (not boostable)
quest.the_fremennik_exiles.route: Recover investigation evidence, craft V's shield with lunar glass, Fossegrimen's altar and geyser relic; defend Rellekka, sail to Isle of Stone, solve a puzzle, defeat Typhor and Jormungand.
quest.the_fremennik_exiles.consumables: One molten glass and astral rune; estimated two kegs of beer; fixed combat food budget. Mirror shield, ice gloves, fishing rod, pet rock, rune throwing axe and seal of passage are held.
quest.the_fremennik_exiles.reward: 2 QP, 50,000 Slayer, 50,000 Crafting and 30,000 Runecraft XP, plus V's shield.
